Monolithic Power Systems new entrant OR displace threat Semiconductors 2026
Monolithic Power Systems vs Semiconductors peers market share trend 2025 2026

findings.claim: 公司 10-K 列出十家主要對手（ADI、Infineon、NXP、ON、Power Integrations、Renesas、ROHM、Semtech、ST、TI），並明言預期持續面對既有對手與半導體市場新進入者的競爭。
findings.excerpt: We consider our primary competitors to include Analog Devices, Infineon Technologies, NXP Semiconductors, ON Semiconductor, Power Integrations, Renesas Electronics, ROHM Semiconductor, Semtech, STMicroelectronics and Texas Instruments.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：對手規模與資源多數大於公司，且因公司為 fabless 不適用 CHIPS Act 補助，對手藉補助擴產、縮短交期並取得份額。
findings.excerpt: Because we operate a fabless business model, we are not eligible for such investments. Many of our competitors benefit from these and other investments, which helps increase their production capacities, shorten their lead times and gain market share.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：競爭者數量因公司所處細分市場擴張而增加，公司承認無法保證產品持續勝出。
findings.excerpt: The number of our competitors has grown due to the expansion of the market segments in which we participate.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到 2026 年具名對手搶走 MPWR 設計案或具名新進入者取代的報導；查到的多為聚合站，無可核原文，故僅列 clue（CSIMarket 稱 Q2 2026 於某區隔失去份額，方法論不明，未核）。

clues.claim: CSIMarket 稱 MPWR 在 Q2 2026 於某區隔份額下滑（儘管整體營收成長 47.68%），區隔與方法論不明。
